# MpmLoader { #timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader }

```python
loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader()
```

Load an MPM-Toolbox MSM+MPM+MPR triple as one multimodal AlignmentBundle.

The loader is given the ``.mpr`` project file; it resolves the sibling
``.msm`` / ``.mpm`` by the bare filenames the project names, parses the
score, the selected modelled performance's markup, and the observed
alignment, and assembles a bundle with a shared logical ``"score"``
group and a physical ``"perf"`` group — the latter also carrying the
spectrogram's graphical pixel axis (``perf:dgt1``) when the project
ships one — linked by one synchronous :class:`MatchClaim` per score
note.  The bundle thus spans the logical, physical, and (when a
spectrogram is present) graphical domains.

**Usage follows the standard loader two-phase pattern:**

1. ``loader.load(mpr_path)`` — ingest the whole project.
2. ``loader.create_bundle()`` — assemble the AlignmentBundle.
3. ``loader.create_timeline(uid)`` / ``create_timelines()`` — retrieve
   individual timelines.

By default the *first* ``<performance>`` in the ``.mpm`` is used.  Pass
``performance=<name>`` to ``load`` to select a different one.

The loader reads the modelled performance and the observed alignment;
it never runs an aligner.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [performance_name](#timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.performance_name) | The name of the selected ``<performance>`` block. |
| [ppq](#timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.ppq) | Pulses per quarter note (read from the MSM/MPM). |
| [tempo_map](#timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.tempo_map) | The modelled quarters→seconds TableMap (from the tempoMap). |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [create_bundle](#timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.create_bundle) | Assemble the AlignmentBundle from the loaded project. |
| [create_timeline](#timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.create_timeline) | Return a single timeline by its uid. |
| [create_timelines](#timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.create_timelines) | Return all loaded timelines: the two score, then the performance. |
| [load](#timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.load) | Ingest a whole MPM-Toolbox project. |

### create_bundle { #timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.create_bundle }

```python
loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.create_bundle()
```

Assemble the AlignmentBundle from the loaded project.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                | Description                                                 |
|--------|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'AlignmentBundle\' | An ``AlignmentBundle`` with a shared ``"score"`` group (two |
|        | \'AlignmentBundle\' | logical timelines), a ``"perf"`` group (two physical        |
|        | \'AlignmentBundle\' | timelines), and one synchronous cross-group MatchClaim per  |
|        | \'AlignmentBundle\' | score note.                                                 |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                            |
|--------|--------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
|        | [RuntimeError](`RuntimeError`) | If ``load()`` has not been called yet. |

### create_timeline { #timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.create_timeline }

```python
loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.create_timeline(uid=None, **kwargs)
```

Return a single timeline by its uid.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                 | Description                                                                                                                                                      | Default   |
|--------|----------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| uid    | [str](`str`) \| None | One of ``"score:clt1"`` / ``"score:dlt1"`` / ``"perf:cpt1"`` / ``"perf:dpt1"`` / ``"perf:dgt1"`` (the last present only when the project carries a spectrogram). | `None`    |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                            |
|--------|--------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`)         | If no timeline matches.                |
|        | [RuntimeError](`RuntimeError`) | If ``load()`` has not been called yet. |

### create_timelines { #timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.create_timelines }

```python
loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.create_timelines(id_pattern=None)
```

Return all loaded timelines: the two score, then the performance.

The performance group always contributes ``perf:cpt1`` and
``perf:dpt1``; ``perf:dgt1`` (the spectrogram graphical axis) is
appended when the project carries a spectrogram.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                 | Description                                    | Default   |
|------------|----------------------|------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| id_pattern | [str](`str`) \| None | Optional regex pattern to filter timeline IDs. | `None`    |

### load { #timetoalign.loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.load }

```python
loader.alignment.mpm.MpmLoader.load(mpr_path, *, performance=None)
```

Ingest a whole MPM-Toolbox project.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                   | Description                                                                                                                 | Default    |
|-------------|----------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| mpr_path    | [str](`str`) \| [Path](`pathlib.Path`) | Path to the ``.mpr`` project file.  The sibling ``.msm`` / ``.mpm`` are resolved from the bare filenames the project names. | _required_ |
| performance | [str](`str`) \| None                   | Name of the ``<performance>`` block to use.  When ``None`` (the default), the first performance is selected.                | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                             | Description                |
|--------|----------------------------------|----------------------------|
|        | [Self](`typing_extensions.Self`) | Self, for method chaining. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                       |
|--------|------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
|        | [FileNotFoundError](`FileNotFoundError`) | If the ``.mpr`` or a sibling it names is missing. |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)               | If a named performance is not present in the MPM. |
